name_jp: リンクアンドモチベーション
summary_en: Tokio Co. and Yuuki Co. to acquire 9,550,000 shares each (8.62% of voting rights each, 17.24% combined) from Phoenix Co. (current shareholder) on June 4, 2026. Acquisition meets thresholds triggering disclosure under Financial Instruments Exchange Act Article 167(1) as regulated large-block acquisition. Both acquirers intend long-term stable ownership.
summary_jp: トキオとユウキが現株主フェニックスから合計1,910万株（議決権合計17.24%）を2026年6月4日に取得。金融商品取引法167条1項該当の買集め行為。両社とも安定株主として長期保有目的。
